info.name: Aerolab local simulator
info.description: Read-only checks against the real local simulator. WebSocket mutations are covered by tests/protocol.test.mjs.

exec: pm.test('healthy live simulator', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.healthy).to.eql(true); pm.expect(b.mode).to.eql('simulation'); pm.expect(b.nominal_loop_hz).to.eql(500); pm.expect(b.snapshot_age_ms).to.be.below(1000); });

pm.test('bounded motor signals', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.type).to.eql('telemetry'); pm.expect(b.motors.pwm_us).to.have.lengthOf(4); b.motors.pwm_us.forEach(v => pm.expect(v).to.be.within(1000,2000)); });

pm.test('watchdog and model boundary', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); const b=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.command_timeout_ms).to.eql(500); pm.expect(b.motors).to.have.lengthOf(4); pm.expect(b.limitations.length).to.be.at.least(5); });
